label: 01-Default
brief: Create a complete premium, attractive and professional website for FIELDNOTE, a fictional independent photography and print studio, in a white theme. Invent the visual identity and composition. Make the full website detailed and useful for someone considering a photography commission or an art print. Use relevant photographs found through Google image search as direct image URLs, without downloading them. Clearly label illustrative work; do not invent real clients, testimonials, awards, prices, studio addresses or contact details. The primary action is an accessible project-inquiry form with useful fields and honest local-only confirmation; nothing is sent externally. Make the website responsive, keep its content and controls usable with reduced motion, and inspect the finished result with the existing preview tools.
